underlying_release: libxml2 2.15.4 and PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom DOMDocument::loadXML (AFL++ overlay, source build); Ubuntu PHP 8.5.4 with libxml 2.15.2 via php8.5-xml (Xdebug coverage image)
coverage_limit: Xdebug line coverage sees only symfony/serializer PHP lines (XmlEncoder::decode and its DOM-to-array walk, plus the interfaces and trait it loads) and is reported separately. AFL++ feedback comes from the native overlay: libxml2 2.15.4 parser.c, parserInternals.c and SAX2.c plus PHP 8.5.12 ext/dom/document.c, instrumented through an allowlist while the same XmlEncoder harness runs; libxml2 tree/XPath code, other ext/dom classes, ext/libxml and the interpreted XmlEncoder code add no AFL++ tuples, so the XmlEncoder lines that differ between the controls are visible only in the Xdebug report. The pinned base image does not bundle php-fuzzer; replay is per case.
